LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherCarapace.label: severance carapace
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherCarapace.description: The Rift Butcher enters through a temporary severance shell, shrugging off the first volley long enough to force a real engagement.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherHookSnare.label: hook-snarled
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherHookSnare.description: A rift hook has bitten into armor seams and dragged the victim's movement into the Butcher's cadence.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSeveredLine.label: severed line
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSeveredLine.description: The victim's stance and aim are briefly split by a Dominion cut, leaving them slow to reposition after the Butcher's sweep or dash.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherExecutionFocus.label: execution focus
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherExecutionFocus.descriptio: The Butcher's failing frame sheds restraint and routes more power into pursuit, hook timing and close-range killing pressure.
